prompt: Die Requirements für die Rezept-App sind fertig gegroomt. Mach jetzt die Architektur.
assertions: Asks no questions: the final message contains no question to the user, no options to choose from and no request to review or approve
Traceability: every story/acceptance criterion and every business rule of the target requirements document is mapped to a concrete design element
No open decisions: the design contains no TBD/TODO, no 'either X or Y' left to developers, no unresolved 'consider'/'if needed' choices
Out-of-scope items of the target requirements are not designed or built
Data model given with entities, fields and types; API/interfaces given with method, path and request/response shape
All written files are in English
Kotlin is used as stated by the stakeholder (at least for the backend) and the choice for each client/frontend is justified against the Kotlin constraint
Frontend, backend and database all run as Docker containers on the Raspberry Pi 5 (e.g. one docker compose file); no external hosted service replaces one of them
The design explicitly requires linux/arm64 images/builds for the Pi
A memory budget with per-container limits is given, the JVM heap is explicitly capped, and the sum fits in 4 GB with headroom for the OS
The 10-concurrent-users requirement is verified by a defined load test (tool, scenario, pass threshold)
Offline reading of previously opened recipes (incl. photo, cooking mode, scaling) has a concrete mechanism (e.g. service worker cache) and failed saves keep the user's input
HTTPS/secure context is provided for the browser clients (needed for service worker and screen wake lock), including how household devices trust it
Cooking mode keeps the screen on via a concrete mechanism (e.g. Screen Wake Lock API)

The import design is based on the real files in /Users/vicokuras/IdeaProjects/rezepte (handles varying heading levels, ingredients written as headings, numbered-heading steps, Short Ribs -> Hauptgerichte, amounts like '1,5 L')
Scaling rule R5/R6 is specified precisely (formula, only ingredient amounts, one decimal, German decimal comma)
